newsitem.title: USA: Oglebay posts record shipping demand.
newsitem.headline: Oglebay posts record shipping demand.

text.p: Oglebay Norton Co said Monday it believes its outstanding operating results for the second quarter and first half of 1997 reflect total earnings strength and it will continue restructuring efforts towards continued growth.

The company said revenues and operating profit for its Marine Transportation division increased in the current second quarter as customer demand continued to be strong in iron ore, coal and stone shipments on the Great Lakes.
Oglebay said its Industrial Sands unit shipped a record 474,000 tons in the second quarter, an increase of more than 25 percent over second quarter shipments in 1996.
